name: io.github.viaanshetty3-debug/relay-whatsapp-mcp
title: Relay for WhatsApp
description: Your WhatsApp as 38 MCP tools: read, search, send and media across accounts, self-hosted.

environmentVariables.name: RELAY_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder with Relay's .env and WhatsApp session (default: ~/.relay-whatsapp-mcp). Run `npx relay-whatsapp-mcp setup` and `start` first.

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of the running Relay bridge (default: http://127.0.0.1:8787)
